entries.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the family-15 incline body laid prone on the same pad (the instructions say chest-down; the stored template reads lying on the back and the instructions win - open question recorded at the checkpoint), legs to the floor. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a chest-supported dumbbell row on an incline bench.

frames.caption: Let both dumbbells hang from the shoulders with the chest on the pad.
Pull with the elbows toward the ceiling.
Row until the shoulder blades pinch.
Hold with the shoulder blades pinched.
Reach a full hang and let the blades stretch apart.

entries.name: Renegade Row
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 28 degrees so both floor dumbbells under the hands, the feet set wider than usual, the straight braced plank line, and the alternating row of each dumbbell to the ribs without hip twist all read clearly: starting in a push-up plank with a hand on each dumbbell and feet wider than usual, rowing one dumbbell to the ribs while the rest of the body stays a statue with hips square to the floor, placing it down, and rowing the other side.
entries.summary: In a push-up plank with a hand on each dumbbell and feet wider than usual, row one dumbbell to your ribs while keeping the hips square to the floor, place it down, and row the other side.

frames.caption: Set up in a push-up plank with a hand on each dumbbell, feet wider than usual.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs while the rest of you stays a statue, refusing to let the hips twist.
Place the dumbbell down on the floor with the hips square to the floor.
Row the other side to your ribs, pulling with the elbow and staying quiet everywhere else.
Place the dumbbell down on the floor with the feet wide for a stable base.
